title: Our Military Discount Returns for Veterans Day
summary: Learn more about Target’s Military Discount, available to military personnel, veterans and their families.
body_markdown:
In conjunction with Veterans Day, Target is offering a[Target Circle Military Appreciation Discount](http://target.com/circle/military) of 20% off one qualifying storewide purchase from Nov. 5 through Nov. 11 to verified military members, veterans and their families who are Target Circle members. This discount is one way we give thanks for the service and sacrifice of our military community this holiday and beyond.


## Getting started


Military guests can use the Target app to verify their eligibility.


Here's how guests can redeem the offer:


- Verify eligibility by registering[on our site](https://www.target.com/circle/military) or in the app


- Create or sign in to their Target account
- Join Target Circle for free
- Verify military status with non-classified documents (photocopies of U.S. government ID or Common Access Card are prohibited)*


- In addition to this offer, guests can:


- Add veteran/dependent status as part of their permanent guest profile
- Become eligible for future offers for verified military and veteran guests
- [Save on Target Circle 360](https://www.target.com/l/target-circle-military-appreciation/-/N-ydibb) membership


## Serving those who served


Target’s military discount is part of our long-standing commitment to supporting the military and veteran community, and our support goes beyond Veterans Day. We support the community all year through programs, including:


- Our military appreciation discount in June/July to celebrate Independence Day
- Team member resources and support through our Military Business Council, one of our employee resource groups at Target
- Membership with[Veteran Jobs Mission](https://veteranjobsmission.com/) in a pledge to hire more U.S. military veterans
- Our contributions to military and veteran causes like the[USO](https://www.uso.org/) ,[Operation Gratitude](https://www.operationgratitude.com/) and[The Mission Continues](https://www.missioncontinues.org/)


**Photocopying any U.S. government identification is a violation of[Title 18, US Code Part I, Chapter 33, Section 701](https://www.defense.gov/News/Feature-Stories/Story/Article/2061835/did-you-know-photocopying-a-government-id-is-illegal/) . Please use non-classified documents issued from your administrative officer or government official as proof of service.*
